turns.customer: I've used the Glowworm headlamp from order #1050 on a few night hikes, and now it won't turn on, even with new batteries. Can I return it?
turns.reply: Because you have used the headlamp, it is not eligible for a standard return since only unused items in original condition can be returned. However, since it stopped working after it arrived, it may be covered under our 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. I have escalated this to a human support agent (Ticket #ESC-29), who will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
